items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. There are several that are reversed. One for Lana Turner – Anal Renrut.

ctx.x: Yeah. There are several that are reversed. One for Lana Turner – Anal Renrut.

That experience with Duke – I listen to what Clark Terry says, “After playing with that band, I do everything like Duke would do it. I conduct my band [with] the same motions that Duke did.” Because he was so powerful that, when you spent a lot of time with him, that rubbed off on you, and you automatically did it. Like he had a way of conducting a four beat – 1 2 3 4 – instead of 1 2 3 4 [gestures unknown]. Clark says, “When I got my own band, I conducted the same way Duke could, because it was so right and so…
